items.body_text:
بریتانیا چند مظنون را در نزدیکی پایگاه مورد استفاده آمریکا در جنگ ایران بازداشت کرد
پلیس بریتانیا خبر داد در پی وقوع «حادثهای بزرگ» در نزدیکی پایگاه هوایی فرفورد، چند مرد را به ظن ارتکاب جرائم مرتبط با مواد منفجره بازداشت کرده است. همزمان، ساکنان مناطق اطراف این پایگاه که در جنگ ایران مورد استفاده ارتش آمریکا قرار گرفته بود، تخلیه شدند.
پلیس یکشنبه پنجم مهر اعلام کرد کارشناسان خنثیسازی بمب ارتش بریتانیا در حال بررسی چند خودرو در نزدیکی این پایگاه در منطقه گلاسترشر در جنوب غربی انگلستان هستند.
سخنگوی دولت بریتانیا نیز گفت اندی برنهام، نخستوزیر این کشور، بهطور مستمر در جریان آخرین تحولات مربوط به حادثه قرار میگیرد.
دولت بریتانیا پیشتر به آمریکا اجازه داده بود از پایگاه فرفورد برای حمله به مواضع موشکی جمهوری اسلامی استفاده کند.
جمهوری اسلامی از این مواضع برای هدف قرار دادن کشتیها در تنگه هرمز بهره میگیرد.
سپاه پاسداران تهدید کرده است هر پایگاهی که برای انجام این حملات مورد استفاده قرار گیرد، «هدفی مشروع» خواهد بود.
یک شاهد عینی پنجم مهر به خبرگزاری رویترز گفت ماموران پلیس مسلح مسیر دسترسی به دروازه اصلی پایگاه فرفورد را مسدود کردهاند و تجهیزاتی مقابل ورودیهای آن مستقر شده است.
به گفته این شاهد، ساکنان یکی از روستاهای مجاور نیز خانههای خود را ترک کرده و به یک مرکز ورزشی و تفریحی انتقال یافتهاند.
به گزارش رویترز، حدود ۳۰ وسیله نقلیه امدادی، از جمله خودروهای پلیس، آمبولانسها و خودروهای آتشنشانی، در روستای فرفورد در نزدیکی این پایگاه مستقر شدهاند.
این تحولات در شرایطی رخ میدهد که اد میلیبند، وزیر خارجه بریتانیا، دوم مهر در دیدار با عباس عراقچی، وزیر امور خارجه جمهوری اسلامی، هشدار داد لندن ارعاب، تهدید یا فعالیت خصمانه گروههای مرتبط با حکومت ایران در خاک بریتانیا را تحمل نخواهد کرد.
این دیدار در حاشیه مجمع عمومی سازمان ملل متحد در نیویورک برگزار شد.
۲۰ خرداد، ۲۲ کشور در آمریکای شمالی، اروپا و اقیانوسیه در بیانیهای مشترک، «اقدامات تروریستی» جمهوری اسلامی در خاک خود را محکوم کردند و هشدار دادند تهران باید فورا به این اقدامات پایان دهد.
بازداشت چند مظنون و تشدید تدابیر امنیتی
پلیس شهرستان گلاسترشر پنجم مهر در بیانیهای اعلام کرد: «در پی اعلام وقوع حادثهای بزرگ و بازداشت چند مرد به ظن ارتکاب جرائم مرتبط با قانون مواد منفجره، شماری از ساختمانها در منطقه ولفورد در حال تخلیه هستند.»
پلیس افزود تیم تخصصی خنثیسازی مواد منفجره ارتش در حال بررسی چند خودرو است و به نظر میرسد وضعیت اکنون تحت کنترل قرار گرفته باشد.
سخنگوی نیروی هوایی آمریکا از اظهارنظر درباره تدابیر امنیتی مشخص این نهاد نظامی خودداری کرد.
او گفت: «یگان پشتیبانی رزمی ۵۰۱ و دیگر یگانهای ما در بریتانیا همچنان هوشیار هستند و اقدامات لازم را برای تامین امنیت نظامیان آمریکایی، کارکنان غیرنظامی، پیمانکاران و خانوادههای آنها انجام خواهند داد.»
به گفته او، نیروی هوایی آمریکا بهطور مداوم عوامل گوناگون را ارزیابی میکند تا درباره اتخاذ یا تغییر تدابیر حفاظتی برای تاسیسات، کارکنان و خانوادههای آنها تصمیم بگیرد.
بریتانیا در ماه ژوئیه و بهدنبال هشدار سپاه پاسداران درباره استفاده بمبافکنهای آمریکایی از پایگاه فرفورد اعلام کرد نیروهای مسلح این کشور برای مقابله با هرگونه حمله احتمالی آمادگی دارند.
افزایش تهدیدهای فرامرزی جمهوری اسلامی در سالهای اخیر، به نگرانیها درباره گسترش شبکههای نفوذ حکومت ایران، بهویژه سپاه پاسداران، دامن زده است.
همزمان با ادامه تنشها و چشمانداز مبهم مذاکرات تهران و واشینگتن، کریس رایت، وزیر انرژی آمریکا، اعلام کرد میانگین انتقال روزانه نفت از تنگه هرمز به حدود ۱۳ میلیون بشکه رسیده است.
رایت یکشنبه پنجم مهر در مصاحبه با شبکه فاکسنیوز گفت: «در یکی از روزها در هفته گذشته، بیش از ۲۰ میلیون بشکه نفت از تنگه هرمز عبور کرد که حتی از میزان پیش از آغاز جنگ نیز بیشتر بود.»
به گفته او، اقدامات نیروهای مسلح آمریکا به احیای جریان انتقال نفت، گاز، فرآوردههای نفتی و حتی کود شیمیایی از این آبراه کمک کرده است.
تنگه هرمز گذرگاه باریکی میان ایران و عمان است که پیش از آغاز جنگ در ۹ اسفند ۱۴۰۴، روزانه بهطور متوسط حدود ۲۰ میلیون بشکه نفت از آن عبور میکرد؛ رقمی که حدود یکپنجم عرضه جهانی نفت را تشکیل میداد.
جمهوری اسلامی سوم مهر پیشنهاد کرد در ازای رفع محاصره دریایی، صدور معافیت تحریمی برای فروش نفت و برقراری آتشبسی که لبنان را نیز شامل شود، تنگه هرمز را بازگشایی کند و مذاکرات با آمریکا را در چارچوب طرحی هفتروزه از سر بگیرد.

items.summary: لوئیس دلافوئنته، سرمربی تیم ملی اسپانیا، پس از پیروزی ۳ بر ۲ مقابل انگلیس گفت که تیمش همچنان تشنه پیروزی و موفقیت است و به جهان نشان داده که هیچ قصدی برای متوقف‌کردن روند پیروزی‌های خود ندارد.

items.summary: علی تاجرنیا، رییس هیات مدیره باشگاه استقلال در یک گفتگوی اینترنتی، گفت که فدراسیون فوتبال به او قول داده که جام قهرمانی فصل گذشته که با صدرنشینی آبی‌پوشان، نیمه‌تمام ماند را به استقلال می‌دهند: «به صراحت می‌گویم که این قول به من داده شده که جام قهرمانی را به ما بدهند.»

items.summary: یوکی کوریهارا، بازیکن ۱۱ ساله ژاپنی، با پیروزی ۱۰ بر ۲ حریف ۲۴ ساله کره‌ای در فینال «پویو پویو چمپیونز»، بازی معمایی ورزش‌های الکترونیکی، طلای بازی‌های آسیایی ۲۰۲۶ ناگویا را به دست آورد. او در نیمه‌نهایی حریف ۲۸ ساله تایلندی را ۱۰ بر یک شکست داده بود.

items.summary: جورج راسل، راننده مرسدس، در رقابتی نفس‌گیر با مکس فرستاپن از ردبول، با اختلاف تنها ۰.۱۹۶ ثانیه برنده گرندپری باکو در جمهوری آذربایجان در رقابت‌های فرمول یک شد. فرستاپن که مسابقه را از رده هشتم آغاز کرده بود، در دورهای پایانی به راسل رسید، اما نتوانست از او عبور کند.

items.summary: زهرا زارعی در فینال دوی ۴۰۰ متر مسابقات دوومیدانی زنان بازی‌های آسیایی ۲۰۲۶ ناگویا با ثبت زمان ۵۲ ثانیه و ۳۸ صدم ثانیه دوم شد و مدال نقره گرفت. این نخستین مدال تاریخ زنان ایران در مواد دو در بازی‌های آسیایی است.

items.title: Men Arrested Near UK Air Base Used By US Forces In Iran War
items.summary: As the conflict in the Persian Gulf continues to impact and shape the region, journalists from RFE/RL's Central Newsroom and Iranian service, Radio Farda, deliver ongoing updates and analysis.
items.body_text:
Men Arrested Near UK Air Base Used By US Forces In Iran War
British police have arrested several men on suspicion of explosives offenses near an air base used by US forces, prompting the evacuation of residents from nearby homes.
Police declared a major incident on September 27 near RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire, western England, and said army bomb-disposal experts were examining several vehicles.
RAF Fairford is used by the US Air Force and has been used for US military operations against Iran.
Several properties in the nearby village of Whelford were evacuated, and residents were taken to a local leisure center, police said.
Armed police were seen blocking access to the main gate of the base, according to Reuters.
In March, Britain granted the United States permission to use RAF Fairford and another British base for what the government described as specific and limited defensive action against Iranian missile facilities. The permission was later extended to missile sites and capabilities threatening shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps warned in July that any base used for strikes against Iran would be considered a legitimate target, according to Reuters.
There was no immediate indication that the arrests were connected to Iran or to any foreign government.
The US Air Force said it remained vigilant and would take appropriate measures to protect US personnel, civilians, contractors, and their families, according to Reuters.
British authorities have also warned in recent months about the threat of hostile activity and possible sabotage by state actors, including Russia. The British government has said it does not comment on specific intelligence or security threats.
Gloucestershire police said it believed the incident was contained.
UPDATE: The BBC is reporting that a wheeled robot is operating next to three parked white vans. A British Army explosive ordnance disposal team has been examining vehicles in the village of Whelford, police said earlier.
US Treasury Chief Hails Success Of New Economic Measures On Iran
US Treasury chief Scott Bessent said he had deployed representatives around the globe to pressure countries to economically isolate Iran, citing new restrictions that have targeted the Islamic republic's airline and banking sectors.
"At my direction, teams were dispatched across the globe to engage with countries and demand action against the Iranian regime," he wrote on X. "These efforts are delivering results."
Bessent said the United Arab Emirates has stopped all flights by Iranian airlines and that Turkey and Oman have halted incoming flights from Mahan Air.
The UAE's emirate of Dubai is a major destination for Iranian carriers, with multiple flights each day, and a large Iranian community.
A Wall Street Journal article shared by Bessent said Treasury's assistant secretary for terrorist financing traveled across the Middle East and Europe over two weeks to press the plan to impose what Bessent called "economic D-Day" on Iran.
Discussions were held with more than 50 countries, the Journal reported.
With reporting by AFP
Saudis Call On Global Community To Help Ensure Free Sea Traffic In Region
Saudi Arabia called on UN members to join efforts to defend freedom of navigation in vital Middle East waterways, calling the current situation a threat to global energy security.
"The international community has been absent from assuming its responsibilities in confronting all that threatens international peace and security," Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan told the UN General Assembly on September 26.
Iran has disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, and its Houthi allies in Yemen have done similar actions in the Bab al-Mandab Strait. Both are crucial routes for transit of oil and gas exports.

items.title: Russian Strikes On Ukraine As Zelenskyy Says Russia Not Ready To End War
items.summary: Russian drone strikes killed at least four people in Ukraine overnight and into September 27.
items.body_text:
Russian drone strikes killed at least four people in Ukraine overnight and into September 27, including one person in the capital, Kyiv, and three in the southeastern Zaporizhzhya region, Ukrainian officials said.
In Kyiv, a man was killed when a Russian drone struck a nonresidential building in the Solomyansky district, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said.
A fire broke out at a car-repair facility in the same district, while another nonresidential building was hit, the agency said.
It shared images showing firefighters battling fires at the damaged buildings.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a Russian strike on the Shevchenkivsky district injured a woman and two 16-year-old children. The three were hospitalized, he said.
In the Zaporizhzhya region in the country's southeast , three people were killed in Russian strikes, according to the regional military administration.
A man was killed in the village of Komyshuvakha, where one house was destroyed and several others damaged, it said. Two more people, a man and a woman, were killed when a Russian strike hit their car in the village of Novotavriyske.
Four people were also wounded in the attack on Komyshuvakha, the administration said.
Trump Tells Kyiv To 'Settle' War
Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump has declined to confirm that he had agreed to allow Ukraine to produce Patriot missiles, despite Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's statement on September 25 that Trump had made a “final decision” to grant Kyiv a license to produce the air-defense missiles.
Asked about the Patriot agreement on September 26, Trump said he wanted Zelenskyy and Russian President Vladimir Putin to “settle” their war.
Trump and Zelenskyy met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York on September 22.
“We talked about a lot of different subjects, and many of those subjects...very strong agreement,” Trump told reporters about the meeting.
“But you know what I want him to do? Make a deal. I want him to settle with Putin, and I want Putin to settle with him.”
Zelenskyy said after the meeting that he hoped Washington would help end the war “as soon as possible.” He has also called on Trump to maintain pressure on Moscow, including through new sanctions.
Zelenskyy: Putin Seeks Excuses To Keep Fighting
In his latest nightly video address, Zelenskyy said Moscow is showing no signs it is ready to end its war on its neighbor and he called on the West to remain united in efforts to force the Kremlin to the negotiating table.
“Obviously, the Russians are not preparing to stop their war, at least for now,” Zelenskyy said, citing intelligence reports that Moscow is intending to hike spending on deadly jet-powered drones and other munitions.
Putin “always finds some lame excuse -- not to meet, not to hold a trilateral, not to talk, not to end it, not to stop the killing.”
“It has been the same with him for years – and all our partners feel it. He is looking for excuses to keep waging the war. It always sounds the same -- and our recent meeting with the US president showed that,” Zelenskyy added in the September 26 address.
'Expand Their War'
The Ukrainian leader claimed that Russia plans to spend $12 billion in the upcoming year on the production of “jet-powered drones and loitering munitions alone -- just on this one category of weapons.”
“This directly concerns our partners as well. Many intelligence services have information that the Russians want to expand their war, their activities, to more countries. Perhaps to other regions. That is why we need to build our defense together. That is why we need to defend ourselves together, preventively.”
He said Ukrainian air defenses have been able to intercept 55 percent of jet-powered drones launched by Russia as overnight attacks on Kyiv and other cities have become increasingly frequent as cold weather starts to set in.

items.title: Attack On Security Checkpoint In Pakistan Kills 13, Injures Dozens More
items.summary: Thirteen people were killed and at least 35 others injured following a blast at a security checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan, near the border between Pakistan's Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces.
items.body_text:
Thirteen people were killed and at least 35 others injured following a blast at a security checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan, near the border between Pakistan's Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces.
According to local police, an explosives-laden vehicle was driven into a checkpoint jointly operated by Pakistani police, the military, and customs personnel on September 26.
Officials from Pakistan's emergency services called the incident a "militant attack" and said 11 people were killed, including six customs officers, two women, two men, and a child.
The department added that rescue teams had arrived at the scene and begun rescue operations, providing medical assistance to the injured and transporting them to a local hospital.
The head of the department, Imran Faizi, told Radio Azadi that after the attack gunmen opened fire on ambulances carrying the dead and wounded, killing two rescue workers and injuring two others.
While no group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack, the department has blamed the attack on the banned Tehrik-e Taliban Pakistan (TTP), also known as the Pakistani Taliban.
The incident came amid an increase in similar attacks in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, Pakistan's southwestern province bordering Afghanistan and Iran.
Just a week earlier, an attack involving an explosion and gunfire at a police headquarters killed more than 30 people and injured dozens others in the Pakistani city of Kohat.
Following that incident, Pakistan's President Asif Ali Zardari urged the "complete elimination" of the TTP and "terrorists operating with foreign backing."
Islamabad has blamed the attacks on armed groups originating from and linked to Afghanistan, while the Taliban government there has denied Kabul's involvement.
The tensions have led to repeated clashes between the two countries in recent years, including a number of incidents along the border.

items.title: Floods and landslides kill at least 56 people in India, 12 in Nepal
items.summary: Authorities report increasing death toll over three days as rivers rise above danger levels in parts of both countries.
items.body_text:
Floods and landslides kill at least 56 people in India, 12 in Nepal
Authorities report increasing death toll over three days as rivers rise above danger levels across parts of neighbouring countries.
Heavy rainfall has triggered floods and landslides that have killed at least 56 people in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh in recent days while 12 people have been reported dead in neighbouring Nepal.
Hrishikesh Bhaskar Yashod, Uttar Pradesh’s relief commissioner, said on Sunday that India’s most populous state had registered 66.5mm (2.6 inches) of rain from Friday to Sunday morning, compared with a normal 7.6mm (a quarter of an inch) for the period.
Recommended Stories
list of 3 items
- list 1 of 3Nepal’s leader labels devastating flood a ‘warning to the world’
- list 2 of 3Photos: Heavy rains and flooding in Bangkok force thousands into shelters
- list 3 of 3Hurricane Polo lashes Mexico as Nolo strengthens near Hawaii
The deaths, in addition to 46 injuries, were reported during a spell of “exceptionally heavy rain that has affected much of Uttar Pradesh”, according to the commissioner’s office.
More than 1,000 houses were damaged after “a depression over the Bay of Bengal moved inland and intensified rainfall across the region,” it added.
Home to more than 240 million people, Uttar Pradesh is frequently hit by rain and thunderstorms during the annual monsoon season from June to September.
In India’s eastern state of Odisha, more than 70,000 people living in low-lying areas were evacuated after rivers rose due to heavy downpours, the NDTV news network reported. The rains have damaged bridges and culverts, forcing officials to shut down Devkund, a popular tourist spot in the state.
Separately, India’s Central Water Commission said 30 river-monitoring stations across seven states were in a “severe situation”. Major rivers that flow through India, including the Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, Bagmati and Narmada, had risen above danger levels.
In Nepal, where a devastating flood in late August killed more than 1,400 people and left thousands missing, a new wave of flooding and landslides has killed at least 12 people since Thursday, according to officials, with several others missing.
Authorities warned of possible flash floods in 49 of the country’s 77 districts, with more than half facing high flooding or flash-flooding risks as water levels in major rivers and tributaries continued to rise.
Power supplies have been disrupted in the Manang, Mustang, Myagdi and Baglung districts, with authorities working to restore electricity, officials at the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation said.
Flooding of the Rahuganga River damaged the structure and transmission-line towers of a 40-megawatt hydropower project, Water Resources and Energy Minister Biraj Bhakta Shrestha said.
Shanti Mahat, a spokesperson for the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority, said Rasuwa and Nuwakot, areas hit by last month’s deadly floods, should remain “alert” but were not currently considered high-risk areas.

items.title: ‘No role for UNRWA in Gaza’: Does the Board of Peace toe Israeli lines?
items.summary: Board of Peace excludes UNRWA from Gaza, aligning with repeated Israeli calls to sideline the refugee aid agency.
items.body_text:
‘No role for UNRWA in Gaza’: Does the Board of Peace toe Israeli lines?
Board of Peace excludes UNRWA from Gaza, aligning with repeated Israeli calls to sideline the refugee aid agency.
The United States-led Board of Peace (BoP) has said the United Nations agency for Palestinian refugees (UNRWA) will have no role in Gaza – echoing a longstanding Israeli demand to sideline the organisation considered a lifeline for millions of Palestinians.
The board, which has been tasked with overseeing the “ceasefire” and Gaza’s reconstruction, said on Friday it would work only with partners it deems reliable and who it believes can meet the needs of Gaza’s population – a standard it says UNRWA does not meet.
Recommended Stories
list of 3 items
- list 1 of 3Gaza watches Israel’s elections with fear and antipathy
- list 2 of 3Gaza’s recovery needs reach $71.5bn amid ‘most severe economic crisis’: UN
- list 3 of 3Israel’s policies threaten ‘very existence’ of Palestinians, Abbas tells UN
The move comes as the BoP unveiled a multibillion-dollar plan on Wednesday aimed at beginning Gaza’s reconstruction, nearly a year after a so-called “ceasefire” came into effect in the devastated Palestinian territory.
The plan, presented on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly (UNGA), comes as key elements of the “ceasefire” remain stalled, including the withdrawal of Israeli forces and the disarmament of Hamas.
UNRWA was established in 1949 to cater to tens of thousands of Palestinians displaced from their homes by Jewish militias from areas that currently form part of Israel.
BoP’s stance on UNRWA comes as Israel’s genocide in the coastal enclave continues, with Palestinians facing nonstop attacks, severe restrictions on humanitarian aid and stalled reconstruction plans.
“Excluding UNRWA is not a neutral administrative decision; it is a deeply political one,” Palestinian political analyst and playwright Ahmed Najar told Al Jazeera.
“It aligns the Board of Peace with Israel’s longstanding campaign to marginalise and ultimately dismantle the agency, removing it not only from Gaza’s present but from its future.”
So what has BoP said about UNRWA, and does it keep toeing the Israeli line on the future of Gaza?
What did the Board of Peace say?
The BoP unveiled a 66-project reconstruction blueprint on the sidelines of the UNGA, with $2.4bn proposed for projects aimed at beginning Gaza’s recovery.
UNRWA was left off the list of UN agencies the board identified as partners.
“The Board of Peace’s policy as it relates to UNRWA’s involvement in Gaza is unchanged,” the BoP said in a post on X on Friday.
“We will only work with trusted partners who will deliver for the people of Gaza and contribute to a deradicalised Strip. UNRWA fails on those litmus tests.”
However, a BoP official, speaking to The Associated Press news agency on condition of anonymity, confirmed that board members had met UNRWA officials several times.
The official said the agency’s programmes could continue if they served Gaza’s residents well, but maintained that “UNRWA’s days are over”.
The BoP, which US President Donald Trump launched earlier this year, was conceived to oversee the rebuilding of Gaza after nearly three years of Israel’s genocidal war on the Strip.
What has UNRWA said?
In an indirect response, UNRWA acting Commissioner-General Christian Saunders said on Friday in Gaza, “UNRWA remains an institution of considerable humanitarian and strategic value, with capabilities and expertise that are difficult to replicate today.”
“To disregard these capabilities at a moment of such profound need is neither logical nor responsible,” Saunders said in a statement.
Former UNRWA chief Philippe Lazzarini on Thursday warned that removing the agency would have a “devastating” effect on Palestinians.
“They want to get rid of the agency, but on the other hand they know that if you get completely rid of the agency today, it might have a further … devastating impact on the population,” Lazzarini told A

items.title: باتجاه آسيا.. روسيا تعيد رسم خارطتها الاقتصادية بعيدا عن الغرب
items.summary: تمثل مدينة فلاديفوستوك الروسية بوابة موسكو نحو آسيا، حيث تعيد روسيا رسم خارطتها الاقتصادية بعيدا عن الغرب، عبر شراكات موسعة مع الصين والهند وكوريا الشمالية.
items.body_text:
باتجاه آسيا.. روسيا تعيد رسم خريطتها الاقتصادية بعيدا عن الغرب
تُعتبر مدينة فلاديفوستوك الروسية على حافة المحيط الهادي نافذة موسكو على الشرق، وبوابة اقتصادية وعسكرية وجيوسياسية نحو آسيا، أُسِّست في منتصف القرن الـ19، وشكلت موقعا عسكريا وسدا أمام الهجمات اليابانية قبل أن تتحول إلى مركز إستراتيجي في ظل تحول موسكو نحو الشرق.
ويرى مراقبون أن انضمام اليابان وكوريا الجنوبية إلى العقوبات الغربية على روسيا بسبب حرب أوكرانيا جعل حضور الصين أعمق، رغم تنامي حركة الحاويات عبر ميناء فلاديفوستوك مع طوكيو وسول، وكأن منطق التجارة لا يخضع دائما لقواعد السياسة، بحسب تقرير أعده أمين درغامي، مراسل الجزيرة في موسكو.
قصص مقترحة
list of 2 items
وفي السياق، يشير الرئيس الروسي فلاديمير بوتين إلى أن بلاده ضخت نحو 25 تريليون روبل لتنمية الشرق الأقصى، ونجحت في تطبيق نظم تفضيلية هناك وفي القطب الشمالي.
ويضيف أن هذا البرنامج يعمل على تطوير خط ملاحي يربط سان بطرسبورغ بالقطب الشمالي وصولا إلى فلاديفوستوك وجنوب آسيا، بهدف منح الإمدادات العالمية مرونة وأمانا في ظل الظروف الدولية الصعبة.
ومن جهة أخرى، دفعت الضغوط الغربية موسكو نحو تنويع شراكاتها، إذ بلغ التعاون العسكري والأمني مع كوريا الشمالية ذروته في صيف 2024 بتوقيع اتفاقية دفاع مشترك، ثم مشاركة عسكريين كوريين في معارك كورسك الحدودية مع أوكرانيا. أما مع الهند، فيشير التقرير إلى أن موسكو حافظت على براغماتية تجارية، مع زيادة الاعتماد على النفط الروسي.
أوروبا أغلقت أبوابها
وتظهر الأرقام أن التعاون الروسي مع دول آسيا تضاعف منذ اندلاع حرب أوكرانيا، في مقابل انكماش يقارب ضعفين مع أوروبا، ما يعكس ملامح لتحول جذري في البوصلة الاقتصادية الروسية.
ويرى مراقبون أن منتدى فلاديفوستوك الاقتصادي يجسد هذا التوجه، حيث يتراجع الاهتمام بالغرب بسبب تراكمات الصراع، بينما يتعاظم حضور الشرق بتطلعات ووعود كبيرة.
في السياق، يشير المحلل السياسي والخبير الإستراتيجي إليكسي ماسلوف إلى أن موسكو لم تتخل عن أوروبا، بل إن أوروبا هي من أغلقت أبوابها، مشيرا إلى أن التعاون مع الآسيويين يرتكز على حوار متكافئ تفتقده دول عدة، ويبدو واعدا في مجالات مختلفة، لكنه لا يخلو من تحديات للجانبين.
وفي المقابل، يؤكد رئيس اتحاد رواد الأعمال الصينيين في روسيا، جو لي تسيون، للتقرير أن الصين كانت أكبر شريك تجاري لروسيا خلال العقد الماضي، وأن حجم التبادل بينهما قد يصل إلى 300 مليار دولار قريبا، مدعوما ببنية "الشرق الأقصى الروسي" المتطورة والظروف السياسية الجيدة بين البلدين.
ويخلص درغامي إلى السؤال: هل يصبح الشرق بديلا كاملا عن الغرب، أم أنه مجرد شريان عبور في زمن القطيعة؟ ويجيب بأن الأكيد هو أن روسيا تعيد رسم خريطتها الاقتصادية والسياسية، وأن فلاديفوستوك أصبحت رمزا لهذا التحول الذي قد يعيد تشكيل موازين القوى في آسيا والعالم.

items.title: أفغانستان تعلن قتل وجرح عشرات المسلحين بعد عبورهم من باكستان
items.summary: اتهمت وزارة الدفاع الأفغانية المخابرات الباكستانية بتدريب ونقل عناصر أمن أفغانيين سابقين لشن هجمات في نورستان، بعد عملية عسكرية أفغانية ضد مجموعة مسلحة عبرت من باكستان وسط توتر أمني متصاعد.
items.body_text:
أفغانستان تعلن قتل وجرح عشرات المسلحين بعد عبورهم من باكستان
أعلنت وزارة الدفاع الأفغانية -اليوم الأحد- أن قواتها قتلت 28 مسلحا وأصابت 32 آخرين في إقليم نورستان شرقي البلاد، وذلك بعد عبور مجموعة من باكستان قالت الوزارة إنها تضم عناصر من تنظيم الدولة الإسلامية.
وحسب الوزارة، فإن "جماعات باكستانية دعمت هؤلاء المسلحين، وأن معظمهم كانوا عناصر سابقا في الأجهزة الأمنية الحكومية الأفغانية".
قصص مقترحة
list of 2 items
وأوضحت الوزارة أن المجموعة عبرت إلى كامديش، وهي منطقة تابعة لنورستان قرب الحدود الباكستانية، أمس السبت، بنية شن هجمات، مضيفة أن "القوات الأفغانية أطلقت عملية عسكرية، وفر المسلحون الناجون عائدين عبر الحدود باتجاه مواقع المليشيات الباكستانية".
وذكرت الوزارة أن" أفرادا من القوات المسلحة والمليشيات الباكستانية نسقوا مع المقاتلين، لكنهم انسحبوا عند اندلاع القتال".
كما اتهمت المخابرات الباكستانية بنقل عناصر أمنية أفغانية سابقة إلى باكستان بحجة تقديم المساعدة والتدريب لهم وإرسالهم إلى نورستان.
ويُعد ادعاء كابل بأن المخابرات الباكستانية درّبت وأرسلت عناصر أمن أفغانيين سابقة عبر الحدود اتهاما مباشرا بتورط الدولة في توغل مسلح.
ويأتي هذا الحادث في أعقاب غارات جوية باكستانية على أفغانستان يوم 21 سبتمبر/أيلول الجاري، والتي قالت إسلام آباد إنها أسفرت عن مقتل 28 مسلحا. لكن مسؤولين أفغانيين قالوا إن الضحايا مدنيون، وأكدت بعثة الأمم المتحدة في أفغانستان مقتل 3 مدنيين.
ويأتي هذا الادعاء بعد أقل من أسبوع من شن باكستان غارات جوية داخل أفغانستان، قائلة إنها استهدفت مسلحين.
يذكر أن باكستان اتهمت أفغانستان مرارا وتكرارا بإيواء مقاتلين يهاجمون أراضيها، وهو اتهام تنفيه كابل.

عشرات القتلى والمفقودين في الهند ونيبال جراء فيضانات وانهيارات أرضية
لقي 56 شخصا على الأقل مصرعهم في ولاية أوتار براديش الهندية، و4 آخرون في نيبال المجاورة، في حين لا يزال 10 عمال في عداد المفقودين، جراء أمطار غزيرة وعواصف أدت إلى حدوث فيضانات وانهيارات أرضية وجليدية، وسط ارتفاع منسوب الأنهار إلى مستويات الخطر.
وفي ولاية أوتار براديش، الولاية الأكثر سكانا في الهند بأكثر من 240 مليون نسمة، أعلنت هيئة حكومية لإدارة الكوارث، اليوم الأحد، أن 56 شخصا على الأقل قضوا جراء العواصف والأمطار الغزيرة خلال الأيام الثلاثة الماضية.
قصص مقترحة
list of 2 items
وكانت حصيلة أولية للسلطات الهندية، أمس السبت، قد أشارت إلى مقتل 15 شخصا وإصابة 5 آخرين وتضرر 117 منزلا، قبل أن ترتفع الحصيلة الأحد لتسجل تضرر أكثر من ألف منزل، وسط تأثر 63 منطقة بالولاية.
وأوضح مكتب مفوض الإغاثة أن هذه الظروف الجوية القاسية جاءت بعد أن تحرك منخفض جوي فوق خليج البنغال نحو اليابسة.
وسجلت الولاية هطول أمطار بمقدار 66.5 مليمترا بين يومي الجمعة والأحد، مقارنة بمتوسط موسمي يبلغ 7.6 مليمترات، في حين سُجل خلال 24 ساعة حتى السبت سقوط 19 مثلا لمعدل الأمطار المعتاد في يوم واحد.
من جانبها، حذرت هيئة الأرصاد الجوية الهندية من تزايد الظواهر الجوية المتطرفة كالعواصف الرعدية الشديدة والصواعق، وهي ظواهر يربطها الخبراء بارتفاع درجات الحرارة وتغير أنماط المناخ، علما أن الولاية تشهد عادة أمطارا رعدية خلال موسم الرياح الموسمية الممتد من يونيو/حزيران إلى سبتمبر/أيلول.
قتلى ومفقودون في نيبال
وفي نيبال المجاورة، لقي 4 أشخاص حتفهم، وهم 3 أطفال وامرأة، إثر انهيار أرضي طمر منزلهم أثناء نومهم في قرية "نيشي خولا" بمنطقة "باغلونغ"، وفقا لكبير المسؤولين الإداريين في المنطقة كريشنا براساد أتشاريا.
وأفاد مسؤولون معنيون برحلات التنزه الجبلية بفقدان 10 عمال نيباليين بعد أن طمر انهيار جليدي معسكر القاعدة في جبل "هيملونغ هيمال" الذي يبلغ ارتفاعه 7126 مترا ويقع في منطقة "مانانغ" الشمالية. وكان العمال ينصبون الخيام لمتسلقين أجانب لم يكونوا حاضرين لحظة وقوع الانهيار.
ودفعت هذه التطورات السلطات النيبالية إلى إطلاق تحذيرات من احتمال حدوث فيضانات مفاجئة في 49 منطقة من أصل 77 في البلاد، حيث تواجه أكثر من نصف هذه المناطق مخاطر عالية، مع استمرار ارتفاع منسوب المياه في الأنهار الرئيسية وروافدها متجاوزة مستويات الخطر.
وضربت فيضانات جليدية مدمرة نيبال يوم 26 أغسطس/آب الماضي، وأودت بحياة ما لا يقل عن 1386 شخصا، في حين لا يزال 5130 آخرون مفقودين.

items.title: Xi says to work with Trump to steer China-US ties on steady course
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Thursday that he is ready to work with US President Donald Trump to steer the giant ship of China-US ties on a steady course towards the future.

Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Thursday that he is ready to work with US President Donald Trump to steer the giant ship of China-US ties on a steady course towards the future.
Xi called for strengthened communication, sincere cooperation and peaceful coexistence.
Xi made the remarks while addressing a welcome ceremony hosted by Trump at the White House.
The Chinese president arrived at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday afternoon, kicking off a three-day state visit to the United States.
In his Thursday address, Xi said his visit was for friendship, for cooperation, and for the well-being of both peoples.
Xi said he and Trump encourage their government departments, such as those in charge of foreign affairs, economic matters, financial cooperation, law enforcement and people-to-people exchanges, to catch up on strengthening contact, and they support their legislative bodies in increasing exchanges.

items.title: Xi sends letter to high-level dialogue marking 5th anniversary of GDI
items.summary: Xi sends letter to high-level dialogue marking 5th anniversary of GDI
items.body_text:

    04:07, 26-Sep-2026
                    
                
                CGTN
, Updated 04:28, 26-Sep-2026
Chinese President Xi Jinping has sent a congratulatory letter to a high-level dialogue marking the fifth anniversary of the Global Development Initiative (GDI), held at the UN headquarters in New York on Friday.
Development is the eternal theme of human society and is key to promoting the well-being of humankind, Xi said.
Xi recalled that he proposed the GDI at the UN General Assembly five years ago to advance global development cooperation, reinvigorate the global development cause, and help accelerate the implementation of the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
Over the past five years, with the joint efforts of all parties, the GDI has been widely implemented, with cooperation projects under the initiative taking root and yielding outcomes in more than 120 countries, writing a new chapter of common development and win-win cooperation, Xi noted.
Xi pointed out that nowadays, changes unseen in a century are accelerating across the world, and people in all countries are more eager for development.
As the world's largest developing country and a member of the Global South, China stands ready to work with all parties to uphold a people-centered development philosophy, advance the GDI, turn the vision of the Sustainable Development Goals into reality, and make new and greater contributions to building a community with a shared future for humanity, Xi said.

items.summary: China bags four swimming golds, keeps women's table tennis team title
items.body_text:

    13:39, 25-Sep-2026
                    
                
                Sports Scene
China's Wu Qingfeng displays her gold medal after winning the women's 50-meter freestyle final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Tokyo, Japan, September 24, 2026. /VCG
        China enjoyed another successful day at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Thursday, collecting four swimming titles before the women's table tennis team retained its crown with a 3-0 victory over event host Japan.
Wu Qingfeng got China's gold rush in the pool underway by winning the women's 50-meter freestyle in 23.98 seconds, setting a new Asian Games record and finishing just 0.01 seconds off the continental record. Cheng Yujie picked up bronze for China.
China's Zhang Zhanshuo competes in the men's 800-meter freestyle final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Tokyo, Japan, September 24, 2026. /VCG
        Zhang Zhanshuo then broke the Asian Games record in the men's 800-meter freestyle, touching the wall in 7:42.49 for his fifth gold medal at this edition of the continental competition.
The 19-year-old later returned to help China win the men's 4Ã100-meter freestyle relay alongside Zhao Jiayue, Wang Haoyu and Pan Zhanle. The quartet clocked 3:10.60 to set new Asian and Asian Games records, with the victory giving Zhang his sixth title at Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
China completed its four-gold haul by defending the women's 4Ã200-meter freestyle relay crown. Li Jiaping, Liu Yaxin, Yu Yiting and Li Bingjie finished in 7:49.37, more than 10 seconds ahead of Japan, while the Republic of Korea took bronze.
China's Sun Yingsha celebrates after scoring a point in a singles match against Japan's Hina Hayata in the women's table tennis team final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Aichi, Japan, September 24, 2026. /VCG
        China also topped the podium in women's table tennis, beating host nation Japan 3-0 in the team final to clinch the title for the sixth consecutive edition of the Asian Games.
Sun Yingsha opened the championship contest with a 3-1 (11-4, 11-6, 8-11, 11-7) victory over Hina Hayata, before Wang Manyu came through a five-game battle against Miwa Harimoto, prevailing 3-2 (6-11, 11-4, 9-11, 11-6, 12-10). Kuai Man then completed the sweep by thrashing Mima Ito 3-0 (11-6, 11-5, 11-7).
The triumph gave China its 12th overall Asian Games gold in the women's table tennis team event.

items.title: U.S. failure to appoint Australian ambassador "diplomatic insult": former deputy PM
items.summary: Former Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer has accused the U.S. of hitting Australia with a "diplomatic insult."
items.body_text:
CANBERRA, Jan. 3 (Xinhua) -- Former Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer has accused the U.S. of hitting Australia with a "diplomatic insult."
Fischer, who served as Deputy Prime Minister from 1996 to 1999 under Australia's longest-serving Prime Minister John Howard, on Wednesday said the U.S. administration's failure to appoint an ambassador to Canberra for 18 months indicated Australia was now of "low priority."
John Berry, the former U.S. Ambassador to Australia, resigned in September 2016, leaving the post vacant ever since.
"This is now bordering on a diplomatic insult," Fischer told Fairfax Media on Wednesday. "We've been downgraded, despite all the nice noises. We are a low priority.
Fischer identified U.S. President Donald Trump's opposition to a refugee deal negotiated between his predecessor Barack Obama and Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull as a likely reason for the current administration's failure to appoint an ambassador.
It has long been speculated that Admiral Harry Harris, head of the U.S. Pacific Command, is the likely next ambassador but there has been no confirmation from the White House.
Simon Jackman, head of the United States Studies Centre at the University of Sydney, disagreed with Fischer, saying the delay showed the Trump administration was taking the appointment "extremely seriously."

items.title: South Africa freedom day memorial gathering reveals its pursuit of dignity and inclusive governance in post apartheid era
items.body_text:
IN-DEPTH / IN-DEPTH
                        South Africa freedom day memorial gathering reveals its pursuit of dignity and inclusive governance in post apartheid era
                        Politics finds its rhythm
                        
                     Editor's Note: 
In an era of profound global shifts and increasingly complex regional dynamics, a proper understanding of the world must be rooted in "grounded experience" and localized insights. Global Times English edition, in collaboration with the Academy of International and Regional Communication Studies, Communication University of China, is proud to launch "Local Insights," an English-language column dedicated to original, field-based observations.
We invite Chinese scholars and professionals who are studying, conducting exchanges, or working outside China, as well as international students and friends living and studying in China who are familiar with the social contexts of their home countries or third countries, to begin from first-hand field experience and engage with social, cultural, and contemporary issues beyond China. In the fifth article of this column, drawing on her onâtheâground experience as a Chinese exchange scholar, the author observes a South Africa Freedom Day memorial gathering, revealing how local politics unfolds through collective singing, dancing, and grassroots participation, while also reflecting on the gap between political liberation and economic justice.
As a PhD student, I am currently on an exchange program at Nelson Mandela University in South Africa, with support from the China Scholarship Council. Since arriving here, I have developed a habit of stepping beyond campus whenever possible. Community meetings, municipal events and public gatherings have become a vital way for me to engage with local life. This time, a local friend recommended that I attend a memorial event in Kariega, organized by the Congress of South African Trade Unions (COSATU) in honor of its former president, Phumzile John Gomomo. Beyond that, I had little sense of what kind of gathering I was about to enter.
It was on the way that I noticed the streets were unusually vibrant. Groups of people were dressed in colorful attire, with bright Xhosa headscarves and garments bearing political symbols. My friend then reminded me that it was April 27, which is Freedom Day in South Africa. On this day in 1994, South Africa held its first non-racial election, formally ending apartheid and inaugurating democratic rule. Over the past three decades, Freedom Day commemorates political liberation, while also inviting recurring reflection on whether the promise of freedom has been fully realized. In that sense, Freedom Day marks an important moment for observing contemporary South African politics and social sentiment.
The aerial view of Johannesburg, South Africa Photo: VCG
From street to hall: Entering Freedom Day
The event was scheduled to begin at 10 am, and we arrived shortly before the hour. Yet there were not many people present. Banners of COSATU, the South African Communist Party (SACP), and the African National Congress (ANC) had already been displayed inside the hall, quietly framing the political context of the gathering. Although my understanding was still limited, I could already sense that their presence mattered. COSATU, SACP and ANC represent key forces in South Africa's political landscape, historically linked through the "Tripartite Alliance" formed during the anti-apartheid struggle and sustained in various forms since 1994. I could see that this was not simply a local gathering, but one embedded within a much longer political tradition.
What struck me first was how different the atmosphere was from what I had expected of a political gathering. There was no sense of urgency or visible tension. items.title: China to introduce new train timetable from July 1, including high-speed train service between Beijing and Urumqi
items.body_text:
China to introduce new train timetable from July 1, including high-speed train service between Beijing and Urumqi
                        
                        
                    Passengers are pictured at the Beijing Tongzhou Railway Station in the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center in Beijing, capital of China, May 29, 2026. From 2016 to 2026, the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center marks a decade of planning and development. Over the past ten years, it has undergone a remarkable transformation into a vibrant modern area. Photo: Xinhua
China's national railway network will implement a new train-running timetable starting July 1, which will strengthen connectivity between the country's northwestern provinces and the central, southern, and southwestern regions, while also introducing high-speed train service for the first time between Urumqi, Northwest China's Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and Beijing, the China State Railway Group announced on Wednesday.
Tickets under the new timetable went on sale on Wednesday.
The upgraded network is expected to further enhance railway transportation capacity and operational efficiency. Under the new timetable, China's national railways will operate 12,174 scheduled passenger trains, marking an increase of 106 trains compared with the current schedule.
For example, the railway authorities have arranged 58 high-speed trains from Xi'an in Northwest China's Shaanxi to destinations including Nanyang of Central China's Henan Province, Hankou of Central China's Hubei Province and Chongqing city in Southwest China.
Wan Yaqiong, director of the ticket sales workshop at Xi'an Station under China Railway Xi'an Group, said that the new timetable will introduce direct services from Xi'an to Hankou, with the fastest round-trip travel time controlled within seven hours, according to a report by the China Central Television (CCTV) News on Wednesday.
Additionally, high-speed trains will operate from Yan'an city in Shaanxi to Shaoshan city in Central China's Hunan, establishing a direct high-speed rail link between the two major "red tourism" destinations - historical sites with a modern revolutionary legacy, the CCTV News report noted.
After the timetable adjustment, high-speed trains will run for the first time between Urumqi station and Beijing West station. At the same time, the T-series trains operating between Urumqi and Chongqing West will be upgraded to Z-series direct express trains, shortening the travel time between the two places by more than two hours.
The railway authorities will increase the number of high-speed services during morning and evening rush hours on certain high-speed rail lines in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, providing greater convenience for commuters.

items.title: Chinese expert criticizes Filipino FM's claim that Japan-Philippines delimitation 'nothing to do' with China, warns move serves ulterior purposes beyond bilateral talks
items.body_text:
Chinese expert criticizes Filipino FMâs claim that Japan-Philippines delimitation ânothing to doâ with China, warns move serves ulterior purposes beyond bilateral talks
                        
                        
                    Philippines' Foreign Minister Maria Theresa Lazaro delivers a speech at the Nikkei Forum at a hotel in Tokyo on June 10, 2026. Photo: VCG
In response to the Philippine foreign minister's claim that its boundary discussions with Japan "have nothing to do" with China, a Chinese expert on Thursday said the soâcalled Japan-Philippines maritime delimitation talks concern an area east of China's Taiwan island and contradict international law and the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea. The expert noted the move carries ulterior purposes beyond bilateral discussions.
Philippine Secretary of Foreign Affairs Maria Theresa Lazaro said that establishing clear maritime boundaries between the Philippines and Japan is of vital importance to the country's national defense in an interview on Wednesday.
China has criticized such negotiations, while Lazaro claimed the discussion "has nothing to do with them" and "just between the Philippines and Japan." She added, "We should continue with our delimitation talks," even if China keeps objecting or increases pressure, Nikkei Asia reported.
Lazaro also expressed so-called concern over increasing activities by Chinese vessels in waters close to the Taiwan island, per the outlet.
Ding Duo, Director of the Research Center for International and Regional Issues at the National Institute for South China Sea Studies, told the Global Times on Thursday that Lazaro's words constitute three violations.
First, it violated the international law, in particular the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, which stipulated, in simple words, that "bilateral treaty does not create obligations or rights for a third State." If the Philippines and Japan reach any agreement regardless of China interests, that constitute a violation, Ding said.
Second, such discussions ran counter to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, which stipulated equity in maritime boundary delimitation. Based on this principle, given that the delimitation involves China's interests, and the final decision must not bypass China, Ding added.
The expert further noted that third, in a situation that three parties interests are involved, the acts of Philippines and Japan violated the "obligation of restraint" and "principle of good faith" in international law.
Japan and the Philippines have been hyping so-called maritime delimitation issue recently, concerning an area east of China's Taiwan island. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. agreed to start formal talks on EEZ boundaries and the continental shelf when the president visited Tokyo on a state visit in May, per reports.
In response, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on May 29 that according to China's domestic law and international law including UNCLOS, China has exclusive economic zone and continental shelf in this area. Japan and the Philippines' so-called maritime delimitation talks constitute a severe violation of China's maritime rights and interests, UNCLOS and other international law and basic norms governing international relations. China strongly deplores and firmly opposes that and has lodged serious protests with both countries.
The so-called delimitation talks are completely illegal, null and void, and will have no effect on China's claims to rights in the area east of the Taiwan island or exercise of China's lawful rights. China urges Japan and the Philippines to immediately stop any violation of China's maritime rights and interests and take concrete actions to uphold regional peace and stability.
Ding also noted that in addition to diplomatic methods to break the Japan-Philippines collusion, China can also conduct normal maritime law enforcement, patrol

items.summary: 大美中国，江山如画。 党的十八大以来，习近平总书记的考察足迹遍及神州大地。祁连山麓、坝上林海，秦岭深处、黄河之滨，总书记在大江奔涌处谋划千秋大计，在山川锦绣间擘画生态蓝图。一系列重要论述，为新时代生态文明建设提供了根本遵循和行动指南。 世界环境日到来之际，我们跟随习近平总书记的脚步，一起呵护山水、寄情山水，领悟守护绿水青山、建设生态文明之道。 江河为脉 心系长江之变，习近平总书记前往沿江重镇，考察长江经济带发展。从三峡库区到洞庭湖畔，从港口码头到企业车间，总书记深入调研，作出一系列重要指示，为新时代江河保护治理提供了重要遵循。 2018年4月，习近平总书记来到湖南岳阳城陵矶水文站考察。在狭窄的站房外长廊上，习近平总书记举目远眺。“共抓大保护，不搞大开发”的战略定力，在这里化作守护一江碧水的坚定行动。 2023年10月10日下午，习近平总书记在江西九江市考察，冒雨在江边察看，了解当地长江国家文化公园建设、长江岸线生态修复等情况。10月12日，总书记在进一步推动长江经济带高质量发展座谈会上回顾长江经济带发展历程，感慨：“做就要做好，坚定做下去。笃行不怠，一以贯之，久久为功。” 黄河安澜是中

items.title: 学习手记 | “环境就是民生”
items.summary: 6月5日是世界环境日，也是我国环境保护法确立的环境日。 22年前的这一天，在时任浙江省委书记习近平部署推动下，以农村人居环境整治为重点的“千万工程”启动。 当时，习近平同志担任浙江省委书记刚半年多，工作千头万绪。他何以将农村人居环境整治作为重点工作？ 在基层调研时，习近平同志发现，在浙江经济快速发展的同时，广大农村却面临“成长的烦恼”，村庄面貌不如人意。 全省3.4万个村庄中，人居环境较好的仅4000个。有人形容：“走过一村又一村，村村都是垃圾村。”还有农民这样描述：“起早贪黑赚钞票，垃圾堆里数钞票，躺在医院花钞票。”可以说，人居环境整治是当时浙江农村群众的一个迫切期盼。 “千万工程”聚焦乡亲们走什么村道、怎么处理畜禽粪便等小问题，却直接关系农民获得感、幸福感，是实打实的民生大事。 老百姓的生活环境如何，习近平同志念兹在兹： 上世纪70年代，在陕北冯家坪公社赵家河大队驻点时，他撸起袖管，一石一瓦盖起村里第一个男女分开的厕所； 到正定工作，不仅大力推进“人拉猪吃”的“连茅圈”改造工作，还拿着大扫帚走上街头搞卫生，推动成立全县第一支专职卫生清洁队； 任福州市委书记，亲自为建造垃圾处理场选址

items.title: 全国人大常委会启动节约能源法执法检查
items.summary: 新华社北京6月5日电 为推动节约能源法全面有效实施，促进更高水平、更高质量做好节能工作，全国人大常委会5日启动节约能源法执法检查。 节约能源法自1998年1月1日实施，并于2007年、2016年、2018年进行了修改。 记者5日从全国人大常委会节约能源法执法检查组第一次全体会议上了解到，为全面深入了解法律实施情况，此次执法检查采取实地检查与委托检查相结合的方式，检查组将赴天津、江苏、湖南、广东、广西、四川等省（区、市）开展实地检查，并委托北京、河北、山西、吉林、上海、重庆等省（市）人大常委会对本行政区域内节约能源法实施情况进行检查。检查组将采取实地检查、听取汇报、组织座谈、典型调研、专题研究、抽查暗访等多种方式，全面准确了解法律实施情况，对带有普遍性的问题深入调查研究。 检查组将重点检查8方面内容：落实节能管理制度情况，推进重点领域节能工作情况，重点用能单位节能管理情况，推动节能技术进步情况，实施节能激励措施情况，与法律配套的行政法规、部门规章以及地方性法规的制定情况，法律实施中存在的其他问题，对节约能源法修改的意见和建议。

items.summary: 健全信用修复制度是经营主体信用体系建设的重要内容，是当事人申请解除惩戒措施、重塑信用的制度保障。今年以来，多地深入贯彻党中央、国务院关于全面深化改革、优化营商环境的决策部署，推动企业数据填报“高效办成一件事”和市场监管领域统一信用修复落地见效。 多地完善相关政策 2021年8月，市场监管总局公布《市场监督管理信用修复管理办法》，推动解决信息公示期限较长、信用修复机制不健全等问题。今年以来，在全面深化改革、优化营商环境的大背景下，信用修复再次成为高频词。 在北京，为进一步优化营商环境，北京市市场监管局自2025年起全面升级信用修复服务，通过机制创新、流程优化、精准帮扶等创新举措，今年第一季度已助力6万户企业通过信用修复重塑良好信用。北京市市场监管局信用处副处长丁学雷介绍，为帮助经营主体纾困解难，激发市场活力，北京市市场监管局建立健全常态化信用修复机制，依法依规实现“能修必修、应修尽修”，助力经营主体重塑良好信用。 在江西，各级市场监管部门积极宣传推广市场监管信用修复全国统一平台，引导经营主体通过该平台申请信用修复，并探索推行容缺受理、并联修复等模式，利用各渠道精准推送修复提醒，切实为经营

items.title: 河南卢氏：“小议事”撬动“大治理”
items.summary: 在树下院落、乡间凉亭，一场场热气腾腾的“凉亭夜话”，正悄然改变着河南省三门峡市卢氏县基层治理的面貌。从群众自发到如今党委引领下的制度化实践，“凉亭夜话”不仅成为群众表达心声的平台，也构建起基层治理的创新模式，让“小议事”撬动“大治理”。 “凉亭夜话”源于卢氏县木桐乡群众的自发行动。农闲时，村民围坐凉亭、树下，或为化解纠纷说和相劝，或为某一项目献计献策。卢氏县党委因势利导，对此进行规范化、制度化，并在全县推广。 “凉亭夜话”以开放空间为议事场景，每月至少组织一次群众议事会，激发群众参与热情。同时，明确“五议三不议”原则，划定议事边界。通过建立民情收集机制，形成“民情清单”“议事清单”，配套“四公”议事制度和闭环工作机制，加强督促督办。 2024年，“凉亭夜话”决议落实率高达92%，持续激发干部群众谋发展、干事业、促振兴的内生动力。木桐乡年投资59亿元的钼矿项目落地，创办了创业技能培训中心，打造了“灵神粉条”网红品牌，办起了位于豫陕交界地带的烤鱼店，各项产业红红火火，名列全县“十快乡镇”。全县农村党支部领办专业合作社170余家，涌现出一批集体经济收入超百万元的村。（记者 崔志坚 通讯员 刘

items.title: 北京发布14项举措保障新就业群体权益
items.summary: 本报北京6月4日电 （记者王洲）6月3日，北京市司法局、市市场监管局、市总工会联合发布14项具体举措，构建政策协同、法律服务和维权保障三位一体的制度框架保障新就业群体权益。在公共法律服务方面，北京市司法局组织市、区两级公共法律服务中心、乡镇（街道）工作站为新就业形态劳动者提供法律咨询、法律查询服务以及律师、公证、司法鉴定等法律便利服务，村（居）法律顾问也将常住新就业形态劳动者纳入服务范围；设立“城市蜂鸟”法律援助项目，为在交通事故中不负主要责任、无法认定法律援助条件的网约配送员提供公益法律服务。 同时，北京市市场监管部门将发挥网约配送行业党委作用，及时收集、反映、协调解决网约配送员的问题困难和集中诉求，协同开展“清朗网络平台算法典型问题治理”专项行动，推动平台企业落实算法安全主体责任。市总工会将规范召开企业职工代表大会，落实劳动者四项重大权益保障，开通工会法律服务绿色通道，常态化开展工会特色交通安全、职业健康专项教育。 《 人民日报 》（ 2025年06月05日 14 版）

items.title: 北京出台举措优化入境旅游服务

items.title: “阿大葱油饼”焕新记（干部状态新观察·走进一线探作风）
items.summary: “阿大葱油饼”店铺前排起长队。 受访者供图"> “阿大葱油饼”店铺前排起长队。受访者供图 下午两点，午餐时间已过，上海市静安区石门二路上，“吴根存阿大葱油饼”的招牌下还排着长长的队伍。 “阿大”吴根存在上海颇有名气。他做了30多年的葱油饼，一度是上海街头小吃中的“顶流”。直到3年前老店歇业，“阿大葱油饼”才渐渐淡出人们的视线。 年近七旬的“阿大”坐到店门口休息，厨房里忙碌的，是他的儿子吴志勇。 “想把老爸树起来的品牌再做起来，把葱油饼的手艺传承下去。”摘下帽子、口罩，脱掉围裙，吴志勇满头大汗。曾是外企员工的他，有这个念头已经许久。在上海市区多处考察后，今年4月，一家人选中了石门二路这家门面“老店新开”。 “‘阿大葱油饼’回来了！”随着刚出炉的葱油饼照片、视频在网上热传，新店门前迅速热闹了起来。顾客络绎不绝，店里只得贴出提示：每人限购5只。 生意红火令人欣喜，可没成想，紧接着就收到不少投诉。 4月底，周边商户、居民接连反映：店里的油烟乱排，影响正常经营、生活；马路上排队的顾客有时太多，堵住人行道，阻碍交通。 “街道干部来找我时，我是有点蒙的。”吴志勇说，葱油饼要好吃，需要烤和炸，自然产生

items.title: 优化口岸营商环境没有最好，只有更好（快评）
items.summary: 出台高效举措、优化服务体验、强化硬件设施、搭建高效平台……近年来，海关等职能部门和地方政府密切合作，推出一系列精准有力的政策措施，为激发经营主体活力和助力外贸高质量发展注入强劲动能。 口岸营商环境直接关系到国际贸易的便利程度。优化口岸营商环境，意味着在简化流程、提高效率、降低成本上下功夫。无论是通关时间的缩短，还是报关手续的简化，都显著降低了企业的运营成本，加快了货物的流转速度。 优化口岸营商环境没有最好，只有更好。随着全球贸易格局不断变化，口岸营商环境的优化仍将是一个持续的过程。各地各部门应持续提升政策供给质量，更大程度释放政策效应，推动口岸营商环境向着更加高效、透明、公平、便利的方向发展，有力助推贸易强国建设。 《 人民日报 》（ 2025年06月05日 08 版）

items.title: 将适老化理念融入“诗与远方”（专家点评）
items.summary: 自驾出行、列车出游和旅居康养成为越来越多老年人的选择。 银发旅游蓬勃发展，推动了旅游产业升级。无论是城镇还是乡村，都在努力完善旅游基础设施和公共文化服务。为了更好满足老年游客的需求，还应开发更多适合老年人的旅游线路和产品，并加强博物馆、美术馆、酒店等场所的适老化改造。从硬件到服务，全社会应共同发力，将适老化理念融入方方面面，助力老有所游、老有所乐。 值得关注的是，老年人也可能因信息不对称而遭遇消费陷阱，还可能因为行程安排不当而水土不服。文化和旅游部门要联合市场监管等部门，从社交平台的旅游广告和招徕资质审查开始，重点规范交通、餐饮、住宿、购物、自费项目、医疗保障和应急救援等服务标准，加强对强买强卖、诱导消费、价格歧视等行为的综合监管和专项执法，让老年人畅享“诗与远方”。 （作者为中国旅游研究院院长） 《 人民日报 》（ 2025年06月05日 04 版）

items.title: 习近平总书记关切事｜我们的名字叫“长江”——三个沿江村庄的变迁故事

items.title: 习近平会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科
items.summary: 6月4日上午，国家主席习近平在北京中南海会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科。 新华社记者 黄敬文摄"> 6月4日上午，国家主席习近平在北京中南海会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科。 新华社记者 黄敬文摄 新华社北京6月4日电 6月4日上午，国家主席习近平在中南海会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科。 习近平再次祝贺卢卡申科当选连任总统。习近平指出，中国和白俄罗斯是真朋友、好伙伴。双方一直以诚相待、以信相交。两国传统友好历久弥坚，政治互信牢不可破，各领域合作全面推进。中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中白关系，愿同白方一道，推动两国关系和互利合作行稳致远。双方要进一步加强在联合国、上海合作组织等多边框架内协调和配合，共同反对霸权霸道霸凌，捍卫国际公平正义。 卢卡申科表示，这是我第15次访问中国，每一次都真切感受到中方的深情厚谊。白方感谢中方长期以来大力支持和帮助，对中国高度信任，将坚定不移发展对华关系，积极推进对华合作。在国际事务中，中国坚定维护多边主义，反对单边主义和制裁施压，为世界树立了榜样。白方深表钦佩，愿与中方共同捍卫国际公平正义。 王毅参加会见。 《 人民日报 》（ 2025年06月05日 01 版）

items.title: 习近平向韩国当选总统李在明致贺电
items.summary: 新华社北京6月4日电 6月4日，国家主席习近平致电李在明，祝贺他当选韩国总统。 习近平指出，中韩互为重要近邻和合作伙伴。建交33年来，双方超越意识形态和社会制度差异，携手并进、相互成就，实现两国关系平稳健康发展，不仅增进了两国人民福祉，也为促进地区和平稳定和发展繁荣作出积极贡献。 习近平强调，我高度重视中韩关系发展。当前，世界百年变局加速演进，国际和地区形势中的不确定因素增多。作为全球和地区重要国家，中方愿同韩方一道，坚守建交初心，坚定睦邻友好方向，坚持互利共赢目标，共同推动中韩战略合作伙伴关系不断向前发展，更好造福两国人民。 《 人民日报 》（ 2025年06月05日 01 版）

items.title: 公证档案管理办法修订 推进公证电子档案信息化建设
items.summary: 记者6月4日从司法部获悉，司法部、国家档案局近日印发新修订的《公证档案管理办法》，进一步推进公证电子档案信息化建设，优化公证档案保管期限，完善公证档案利用规则等。 公证档案是记录公证活动过程的基本载体，是国家档案的重要组成部分，是公证执业监督和质量管理的主要依据。办法完善公证档案管理部门职责任务，明确国务院司法行政机关负责制定全国统一的公证档案工作制度，并与国家档案主管部门对全国公证档案工作进行监督、指导和检查。 在推进公证档案电子化与文书材料归档数字化转型方面，办法设专章明确公证档案信息化建设的整体性要求和原则性规定，规定公证电子档案与传统载体公证档案具有同等效力，倡导推进公证档案数字化，并对已经数字化的档案备查提出要求。让静态数据转化为服务动能，更好促进减证便民。 此外，办法依据新修订的档案法及其实施条例，规定大幅缩短公证档案保管期限，将永久、60年和20年的保管期限，相应调整为永久、30年和10年，并制作《公证档案保管期限表》，以附件形式附后。办法明确公证档案保管责任，规定公证机构可以将公证档案的保管期限通过书面告知、办公场所公示等方式告知当事人。规范公证档案销毁条件和程序，明确

items.title: 法治力量护航民营经济高质量发展（代表之声）
items.summary: 《中华人民共和国民营经济促进法》颁布施行，令民营企业界广为振奋。这部法律的出台，承载着民营经济人士多年的期盼，回应了经营实践中的痛点、难点问题，必将开启民营经济发展的崭新篇章。 改革开放40多年来，民营经济从小到大、从弱到强，不断发展壮大。我父辈那样老一代民营企业家视法治建设为企业发展根基，呼吁加强法治保障，对民营经济领域法治建设有着深切期盼。上世纪90年代，许多民营企业家为制定乡镇企业法建言献策。从当年的乡镇企业法，到如今的民营经济促进法，映照了我国从推进农村工业化到构建高水平社会主义市场经济体制的深刻变革。 作为一名来自民营企业的全国人大代表，我有幸参与了民营经济促进法的立法过程。去年在草案征求意见阶段提交了意见，今年全国两会期间又提交了相关代表建议，并列席十四届全国人大常委会第十五次会议，见证了新法的审议和表决。让我印象特别深刻的是，立法过程中，立法机关充分听取民营企业家的意见，相关部门负责同志也专程到我们的驻地，就法律条款进行详细解读和沟通，充分体现了党和国家对民营经济的重视、对民营企业诉求的尊重。 党的十八大以来，党中央出台一系列重大举措，促进民营经济持续、健康、高质量发展。

items.summary: 【本期导读】 “青山绿水是无价之宝。”习近平总书记曾深刻指出，“我对生态环境工作历来看得很重。在正定、厦门、宁德、福建、浙江、上海等地工作期间，都把这项工作作为一项重大工作来抓。” 新时代以来，在习近平生态文明思想的科学指引下，“两山”理念已深入人心，从“点绿成金”的红树林到一座座“花果山”，再到走向世界的长汀经验……美丽中国建设迈出重大步伐，生态环境保护发生历史性变化。国际社会认为，中国取得广泛的绿色发展成就，从根本上源于习近平生态文明思想，特别是“两山”理念的指引。在通过绿色转型推动经济可持续发展方面，中国正成为全球可持续发展的典范。 监制：魏静、戴爽、金近 策划：张倩楠 文案：任丽君 编辑：娄珂馨 视觉：陈佳杰 校对：位树理

items.title: “填一表、跑一次” 辽宁沈阳推出“公民信息连锁变更一件事”
items.summary: 平日里，你有过变更身份信息多次跑的经历吗？如何让更改身份信息快速又准确，来看看沈阳推出的“公民信息连锁变更一件事”。 2024年10月17日，沈阳市“公民信息连锁变更一件事”正式上线。沈阳居民在申请变更姓名、出生日期、民族、性别、居民身份证号码等基本信息时，可以在线下基层派出所或线上的沈阳政务服务网，通过填写一张表单，提交一次变更申请，进行业务办理。审批通过后，公安内部立即启动跨层级、跨警种联动，外部与社保、医保、公积金等部门跨部门联动，开展“串并联”审批。全部完成后，同步发放新的身份证、驾驶证、机动车登记证、机动车行驶证、保安员证、爆破作业人员许可证、社会保障卡，同步变更医保和公积金账户等信息，证照全部邮寄到家。截至目前，全市已经办理相关业务160余件。 沈阳市民邵某是“公民信息连锁变更一件事”的首位体验者，通过沈阳政务服务网“公民信息连锁变更一件事”板块申请变更姓名后，邵某的身份证、驾驶证、机动车行驶证、机动车登记证书，医保、公积金和姓名同步更改，一次申请全部办理完成。 据介绍，“公民信息连锁变更一件事”改革的实施离不开办事流程优化以及多部门数据共享与协同合作。沈阳市营商环境建设局

items.title: 习近平向韩国当选总统李在明致贺电
items.summary: 新华社北京6月4日电 6月4日，国家主席习近平致电李在明，祝贺他当选韩国总统。 习近平指出，中韩互为重要近邻和合作伙伴。建交33年来，双方超越意识形态和社会制度差异，携手并进、相互成就，实现两国关系平稳健康发展，不仅增进了两国人民福祉，也为促进地区和平稳定和发展繁荣作出积极贡献。 习近平强调，我高度重视中韩关系发展。当前，世界百年变局加速演进，国际和地区形势中的不确定因素增多。作为全球和地区重要国家，中方愿同韩方一道，坚守建交初心，坚定睦邻友好方向，坚持互利共赢目标，共同推动中韩战略合作伙伴关系不断向前发展，更好造福两国人民。

items.title: 习近平会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科
items.summary: 新华社北京6月4日电 6月4日上午，国家主席习近平在中南海会见白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科。 习近平再次祝贺卢卡申科当选连任总统。习近平指出，中国和白俄罗斯是真朋友、好伙伴。双方一直以诚相待、以信相交。两国传统友好历久弥坚，政治互信牢不可破，各领域合作全面推进。中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中白关系，愿同白方一道，推动两国关系和互利合作行稳致远。双方要进一步加强在联合国、上海合作组织等多边框架内协调和配合，共同反对霸权霸道霸凌，捍卫国际公平正义。 卢卡申科表示，这是我第15次访问中国，每一次都真切感受到中方的深情厚谊。白方感谢中方长期以来大力支持和帮助，对中国高度信任，将坚定不移发展对华关系，积极推进对华合作。在国际事务中，中国坚定维护多边主义，反对单边主义和制裁施压，为世界树立了榜样。白方深表钦佩，愿与中方共同捍卫国际公平正义。 王毅参加会见。

items.title: 中央网信办等：开展军队文职人员考试培训专项整治
items.summary: 关于开展军队文职人员考试培训专项整治的通告 近年来，一些教育培训机构以军队文职人员考试培训为名违法违规经营，出现无证经营、虚假宣传、借机敛财等乱象，损害了考生权益，严重影响军队形象声誉和考试公平性。为维护人民军队良好形象、考生切身利益和市场经营秩序，现就有关问题通告如下： 一、严禁仿冒军队文职人员考试主管部门官方微信、微博、网站等行为；不得在互联网上擅自解读、曲解军队文职人员管理、军队文职人员考试有关政策或者擅自发布关于军队文职人员考试的不当宣传、不良炒作、欺骗误导考生和社会公众等信息。 二、各类学校不得违规组织军队文职人员考试培训活动，未经批准不得向军队文职人员考试培训机构提供场地，不得为军队文职人员考试培训机构招揽生源提供便利，学校教师和其他工作人员不得违规到军队文职人员考试培训机构兼职、代课，不得参与编写有关培训材料。各级教育行政部门要按照属地管理原则，配合有关部门开展军队文职人员考试培训专项整治工作。 三、军队文职人员考试培训类广告不得对培训效果作出保证性承诺，不得明示或者暗示有关考试机构或者其工作人员、考试命题人员参加培训；禁止不明码标价、价格欺诈行为。 中央网络安全和信息化

items.title: Beijing Court Lets Widow Use Embryos Created With Late Husband
items.link: https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1019073/Beijing Court Lets Widow Use Embryos Created With Late Husband
items.summary: A hospital refused to continue the embryo-transfer process after her husband’s death, citing consent requirements, potential inheritance disputes, and restrictions on assisted reproduction.
items.body_text:
Beijing Court Lets Widow Use Embryos Created With Late Husband
A Beijing court ordered a hospital to resume embryo-transfer treatment for a widow seeking to use two frozen embryos she and her husband created before his death.
On Sept. 22, Beijing’s Chaoyang District People’s Court disclosed details of the case while releasing its annual white paper on medical disputes. The court said it had ruled in favor of the woman, surnamed Zhang, who would be responsible for the related costs. It found that her request did not violate any law, the couple’s agreement, or ethical principles.
Zhang and her husband, Li, married in 2016 and later sought fertility treatment after she experienced repeated miscarriages and Li was diagnosed with secondary infertility. In 2019, the couple underwent treatment at a Beijing hospital’s reproductive center, where three embryos were frozen.
Li died of a brainstem hemorrhage in July of that year. Zhang later used one of the embryos and gave birth to a daughter, leaving two embryos remaining.
Years later, Zhang asked to use the two remaining embryos, but the hospital refused. It cited the difficulty of obtaining consent from her late husband, concerns that the request was linked to an inheritance dispute, a contract provision allowing the embryos to be destroyed if either spouse died, and the lack of approval from the hospital’s ethics committee.
Zhang said she was willing to assume all legal, ethical and moral responsibilities arising from the embryo transfer and any resulting childbirth. Zhang’s mother-in-law supported her decision, and Zhang later filed a lawsuit.
China’s regulations on human assisted reproductive technology, issued in the early 2000s, restrict access to such procedures to married couples and exclude single women.
The hospital argued that Zhang no longer met that requirement after her husband’s death, while Zhang argued that the embryos had been created during their marriage and that she should be allowed to proceed.
The Chaoyang court found that Zhang’s request did not violate the law, the couple’s agreement or ethical principles. It said there was no unresolved inheritance dispute, as Li’s estate had already been settled through notarization and a settlement agreement. The court also found that Zhang and Li had formed a clear, shared intention to have children before his death.
The judges said Zhang’s case differed from that of unmarried women seeking assisted reproductive treatment because the embryos had been created during her marriage. Having already helped Zhang complete one successful embryo transfer, the hospital could not later rely on restrictions on treatment for “single women” to deny access to the remaining embryos, the court said.
The court ordered the hospital to resume treatment, with Zhang responsible for related costs. It said Zhang was an independent rights holder under the embryo-transfer service contract. The judges said disputes involving assisted reproductive technology should balance legal limits, ethical considerations, family consensus and contractual obligations.
The court included the case in its annual white paper on medical disputes, describing it as an example of new legal questions arising from advances in assisted reproductive technology.
Editor: Apurva.
(Header image: E+/VCG)

items.title: Spleen May Affect Cognitive Decline in Women, Says Chinese Study
items.link: https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1019063/Spleen May Affect Cognitive Decline in Women, Says Chinese Study
items.summary: Researchers found that levels of a gene expression regulator rose in the spleens of middle-aged female mice, contributing to cellular demise and potentially explaining why men and women age differently.
items.body_text:
Spleen May Affect Cognitive Decline in Women, Says Chinese Study
Chinese scientists have identified a pathway connecting the spleen to the brain that may in part explain why women are more susceptible than men to cognitive decline as they age.
The study, published Sept. 18 in the peer-reviewed journal Neuron, was led by Ma Huan, vice dean of the School of Brain Science and Brain Medicine at Zhejiang University, in eastern China.
Existing literature shows that although women live on average longer than men, they are more susceptible to cognitive impairment from midlife onwards. Scientists have lacked a clear biological explanation for this phenomenon, attributing it until now primarily to estrogen.
The new research, however, has found that the spleen may influence brain aging through a pathway involving a gene on the X chromosome, which becomes more active in women as they age.
Using gene-expression data from 11 major organs in a preexisting database, the team found that beginning around age 40, signs of cellular senescence — when cells stop dividing and begin to malfunction — rose sharply in women’s brains and spleens, exceeding levels observed in men of the same age. A similar pattern was confirmed in naturally aging mice and in donor human brain tissue.
The researchers’ findings raise a key question: Is cognitive decline in part the result of the body sending a signal to the brain telling it to age?
In searching for that signal, the researchers identified miR-10a-5p, a microRNA — a type of gene expression regulator — whose levels rose in the spleens and brains of middle-aged female mice but not in their male counterparts.
The team then looked for proteins that regulate miR-10a-5p and discovered that RBMX, a protein encoded by a gene on the X chromosome, binds to, stabilizes, and allows the microRNA to accumulate. This process only occurred in female mice, as females carry two X chromosomes.
Next, the researchers injected mice with a compound to block miR-10a-5p, finding this lowered its levels in their brains, as did removing their spleens — indicating that the organ is a major source of the microRNA. Because the compound used does not efficiently cross the blood-brain barrier, the results imply that muting it elsewhere in the body may be enough to alter levels in the brain.
Once inside neurons in the brain, miR-10a-5p suppresses a protein called γCaMKII linked to calcium regulation within mitochondria — structures within the cell that generate its energy. When levels of this protein fall — which occurs during middle age in females — calcium signaling weakens and energy output declines, pushing neurons toward senescence. Restoring the protein in mice with reduced γCaMKII reversed these changes.
“We’ve tended to treat cognitive aging as something confined to the brain,” Qu Jing, the first author of the study, told Sixth Tone. “This work suggests the brain isn’t an isolated organ, and age-related changes in peripheral tissue may start shaping its condition much earlier than we assumed.”
The findings also suggest that because some of the brain’s miR-10a-5p originates elsewhere in the body, testing for it in patients’ blood could help assess brain-aging risk long before cognitive symptoms appear. Second, because reducing miR-10a-5p levels in the body affects the brain, it may be possible to protect against cognitive decline without developing a drug that crosses the blood-brain barrier.
“One important message from this work is that midlife isn’t just a stage where you wait for aging to happen, but a possible critical window for maintaining long-term brain health,” Qu said, adding that because the study points to a connection between the immune system and the brain, sustaining a well-functioning immune system may matter for cognitive health too.
Editor: Marianne Gunnarsson.

items.summary: Shen Zhongmin’s feature debut blends fiction and documentary to reconstruct her father’s decade after he was sent from Shanghai to work on a state-run farm.
items.body_text:
In the Rubber Forests, ‘Shanghai Daughter’ Traces a Father’s Past
SHANGHAI – At the Sept. 19 Shanghai premiere of her feature debut, “Shanghai Daughter,” Shen Zhongmin carried a rubber seed from the forests of the Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, nearly 3,000 kilometers away in southwestern China’s Yunnan province, where her late father had worked.
“The seed fell from the canopy and struck me as I retraced his life there,” Shen, 41, tells Sixth Tone.
Her father was among the millions of urban Chinese youths “sent down” to work in rural areas under the Down to the Countryside Movement, a campaign that ran from the mid-1950s through the late 1970s. He spent a decade on a state-run rubber farm near China’s border with Myanmar but rarely spoke to his daughter about those years.
Shen, who works professionally as Agnis Shen, first traveled to Xishuangbanna in 2011, the year after her father died. A former culture editor at the Shanghai-based magazine The Bund and the author of “The Traveler’s Desire,” a collection of short fiction. She returned to the region repeatedly, retracing her father’s life and meeting people from his generation.
Nearly a decade after her first trip, those encounters and widespread coverage of a herd of wild Asian elephants wandering north from Xishuangbanna helped inspire the idea for a film. The herd’s journey drew attention to the rubber plantations that had transformed parts of the region’s rainforest habitat.
Blending fiction with documentary methods, “Shanghai Daughter” follows Ming, a fictional Shanghai woman played by Liang Cuishan, as she seeks out her father’s former acquaintances in Xishuangbanna.
She encounters workers’ dormitories facing demolition and a landscape where mining and modern agriculture are replacing former rubber plantations. She also meets rubber tappers, village doctors, ethnic Dai villagers, and ecological researchers, all of whom appear as themselves and recount their own experiences.
“The film asks how we deal with memory,” Shen says. “When you want to understand something from the past but cannot find reliable firsthand records, how do you search for the answers?”
“Shanghai Daughter” had its world premiere in the Panorama section of the Berlin International Film Festival in February and was later selected for the Hong Kong International Film Festival and the Malaysia International Film Festival.
Seven months later, the film’s Shanghai premiere drew at least a dozen former sent-down youths from the city, all now in their 70s. They traveled about an hour by subway to attend.
At the theater, they shared old photographs from their years in Xishuangbanna, including images taken with Shen’s father, Shen Wanxiong, and posed for a group photo with the director.
Among them was Shen Weilong, 73, a former rubber tapper who had worked alongside Shen Wanxiong and describes him as his best friend. Looking at one of the photographs, he jokes, “This one doesn’t show just how handsome he was. If you want to know what he looked like, just look at his daughter.”
As he speaks about his generation, tears well in his eyes. “Our generation is rarely talked about, and now our time is running out,” he says.
Sixth Tone spoke with Shen Zhongmin the following day as she continued a multi-city promotional tour. The interview has been edited for brevity and clarity.
Sixth Tone: Not a single scene in “Shanghai Daughter” was shot in Shanghai. Why did you choose the title, and what does it mean to you?
Shen: “Shanghai daughters” was originally a local term. Villagers near the farms used it for daughters left behind by sent-down youths. Over time, the label seemed to replace each woman’s real name.
Because of my father’s history, I am also, in a sense, a “Shanghai daughter,” and so I went there too. In Xishuangbanna, the phrase took on a double meaning for me. items.title: Swiss voters reject initiative to preserve neutrality
items.summary: According to preliminary results published by the Federal Statistical Office, 68.6% of voters opposed the initiative, while 31.4% supported it. Voter turnout was 46.36%
items.body_text:
GENEVA, September 27. /TASS/. Swiss voters rejected an initiative in a referendum that would have enshrined the principle of perpetual and comprehensive neutrality in the Swiss Constitution, as well as lifted anti-Russian sanctions and prohibited Switzerland from joining NATO.
According to preliminary results published by the Federal Statistical Office, 68.6% of voters opposed the initiative, while 31.4% supported it. Voter turnout was 46.36%.
For the initiative to pass, a double majority was required, meaning support from a majority of voters and a majority of cantons. Since 13 out of 26 cantons, including three half-cantons, have already voted against the initiative, it is clear that it has failed. Final results are expected this evening.
items.normalised_title: swiss voters reject initiative to preserve neutrality

items.title: FIDE General Assembly upholds suspension of Chess Federation of Russia
items.summary: Delegates rejected proposals from the chess federations of Armenia, Belarus, Cuba, and Nicaragua to reinstate Russia’s membership by a majority vote
items.body_text:
SAMARKAND, September 27. /TASS/. The General Assembly of the International Chess Federation (FIDE) has upheld the suspension of the Chess Federation of Russia, a TASS correspondent reported.
Delegates rejected proposals from the chess federations of Armenia, Belarus, Cuba, and Nicaragua to reinstate Russia’s membership by a majority vote.
Speaking at the event, the organization’s President Timur Turlov recalled that the FIDE must abide by the rulings of the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS). He also expressed hope that the FIDE can find a way out of this situation and that one day the Chess Federation of Russia will be reinstated with full rights once the CAS conditions are met.
Earlier, TASS reported that the FIDE Council had temporarily suspended the membership of the Chess Federation of Russia in the organization for failing to comply with a CAS decision.

items.title: Kazakh president dismisses defense minister over drills incident, appoints new one
items.summary: At the same time, Tokayev signed a decree appointing Aidos Myrzakhmetov, commander of the Special Operations Forces, as the new top defense official
items.body_text:
ASTANA, September 27. /TASS/. Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev dismissed Dauren Kosanov from his post as defense minister following the deaths of servicemen during exercises in the Caspian Sea, the presidential press service reported.
"By decree of the head of state, Dauren Zhumataevich Kosanov has been relieved of his duties as Kazakh Defense Minister," the statement said. Kosanov was first appointed to lead the Defense Ministry in 2025. In September, Tokayev reappointed him to the post.
At the same time, Tokayev signed a decree appointing Aidos Myrzakhmetov, commander of the Special Operations Forces, as the new top defense official.
"By decree of the head of state, Aidos Sakenovich Myrzakhmetov has been appointed Kazakh Defense Minister and relieved of his previous post," the press service’s statement said.
On September 26, the president ordered the creation of a commission to conduct a comprehensive review of the Defense Ministry following an incident involving servicemen. On September 24, during Navy exercises on the Caspian coast in the Mangystau Region, 17 servicemen were swept out to sea. Fourteen of them died, and three were rescued. A criminal case has been opened in connection with the incident, and five defense officials have been detained, including the chief of staff and the first deputy commander-in-chief of the Navy. According to investigators, the servicemen were swept out to sea while disembarking from a boat amid deteriorating weather conditions.

items.body_text:
Lavrov unimpressed by German FM’s last-minute UNGA overture (VIDEOS)
German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul arrived at last-minute talks with Moscow with Berlin’s familiar anti-Russia script firmly in hand, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has said.
Wadephul requested the meeting on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly at short notice, Lavrov said. Moscow squeezed him into the Russian diplomat’s packed Saturday schedule before his address.
Asked about the encounter, Lavrov said he invited Wadephul to explain what had prompted to him to ask for the meeting. It was the first direct bilateral meeting between the Russian and German foreign ministers since the escalation of the Ukraine conflict, in which Berlin firmly sided with Kiev.
“He took out his notes and read out a text that completely reproduced what Germany’s leaders publicly and officially say every day,” Lavrov said, saying he had expected something beyond Berlin’s familiar refrain that Russia is the aggressor. The underlying message, as Lavrov described it, was that Wadephul had “deigned” to engage Moscow and Russia should return the favor with concessions on Ukraine and guarantees for Black Sea shipping.

Lavrov says Wadephul came and read from a note the standard talking points Germany has publicly declared for years. “I learned nothing new from this”
Funnily, Lavrov says Wadephul acted in an arrogant way: “Now I… https://t.co/H2cgyLoNuIpic.twitter.com/MmzoBa84ph
Wadephul, he said, also confronted him over an August drone incident in Leipzig that Berlin blamed on Russia without producing evidence.
Lavrov brushed off both complaints in his signature dry manner. He said Russia had not deliberately targeted commercial vessels, while pointing to documented Ukrainian attacks at sea, and mocked Berlin’s readiness to pin drone incidents on Moscow on a “highly likely” basis.
Lavrov ultimately portrayed the meeting as a missed opportunity for substantive diplomacy.
“I honestly told him that I had thought he had something interesting, something unusual... I got nothing new out of it,” Lavrov said. Instead, he quipped, Berlin “could have simply called.”
An unwelcome report
Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova later pointed to another telling detail: some apparently unwelcome reading material waiting for Wadephul at the table.
Placed before the delegations was a report titled “Heirs of Goebbels: Falsification of the Events in Bucha and Bloody Staged Performances of the Kiev Regime.” It lays out Moscow’s case that the 2022 Bucha killings were staged by Kiev and its Western backers. Ukraine and Western governments blame Russian forces for the alleged massacre. Videos circulated online appeared to show Wadephul promptly covering the report with his notebook upon taking his seat and ignoring it.
“Wadephul bashfully covered the report with his notebook and pretended he hadn’t noticed anything,” Zakharova wrote on Telegram, referring to its comparison with Nazi propaganda chief Joseph Goebbels. “Everything is perfectly obvious to everyone – the truth hurts.”
Meanwhile, Wadephul emerged from the meeting sticking firmly to Berlin’s established script, saying Germany was ready for dialogue if Moscow “is ready to give up its war against Ukraine.” He added that Europeans were not keen to leave talking to Russia entirely to Washington.
That concern is hardly surprising. Germany is a driving force behind the so-called “coalition of the willing,” which pushes continued support for Kiev and gained prominence as European capitals found themselves increasingly on the sidelines of diplomacy amid direct Russia-US contacts last year. Its members have continued arming Kiev while calling for greater military preparedness against a potential Russian threat – an approach Moscow has repeatedly criticized as hardly conducive to ending the conflict.
